## Summary

What changes, and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `composer check` passes.
- [ ] A migration change has the matching generation change and a round-trip test.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`, if the change affects behavior.
- [ ] README and docs are updated, if needed.
